title: 第12章 翡翠之塔第13章 等级认证
content_zh:
第十二章 翡翠之塔
魔法公会坐落在加洛斯城南端，那是一幢丝毫不逊色于冒险者公会的庞大建筑物，在加洛斯城，魔法公会又被称为翡翠之塔，站在街上远远望去，就能看见那高高的塔尖。
林立在路上问了几个路人，很快就找到了翡翠之塔的方向。
比起熙熙攘攘的冒险者公会来，翡翠之塔下异常安静，林立站在大门之外，竟是许久也没听见一丝声音，只有一股淡淡的魔法波动从塔内传出，这股魔法波动让林立觉得威严而神秘，就好象自己面对着的，是一座不可逾越的高山一般。
从大门走进翡翠之塔，里面同样是一间宽敞的大厅。
只是一眼望去，大厅里却是空荡荡的，连一个人也看不见。
“这什么情况……”
林立正站在门口发愣，却忽然听到一阵争吵声从楼上传来。
“阴影之城想要屠魔山谷的控制权？可以！不过你们最好有流血的准备！”怒不可遏的吼声从楼上传来，林立抬头望去，正看见一个圆滚滚的灰色身影。
“葛瑞安会长，您太不理智了……”而正被那个身影赶出房门的，是一名四十多岁的中年人，这中年人穿着一件黑色紧身皮甲，浑身上下透出一股浓浓的血腥气，当他回过头来的时候，林立忽然觉得，自己就好象是被一条毒蛇盯上了一般。
等等……葛瑞安会长？
林立忽然想起，中年人先前喊的那个名字，似乎正是安度因要自己来找的人。
想到这里，林立不由多看了那胖胖的身影一眼。
这时候林立才注意到，那身穿灰色法师长袍的身影，看上去已经有些年纪了，长得慈眉善目白白胖胖，就连在发怒的时候，看上去竟也让人觉得他笑容可鞠，林立有点眼晕，这么个象商人多过象法师的胖老头，居然就是加洛斯魔法公会会长，大魔导士葛瑞安！
“葛瑞安会长，您真的是太不理智了，拒绝阴影之城的友谊，只会给加洛斯魔法公会带来灾难。”中年人丢下这么一句话，头也不回的出了翡翠之塔，只是在擦身而过之时，又望了林立一眼，那种仿佛被毒蛇盯上的感觉，让林立没来由的心头一紧。
“这人怎么走路一点声音都没有，难道是鬼上身？”林立这厮本来就不是个肯吃亏的性格，被那目光看得很不舒服，心里自然要骂上两句。
“有种你们就来！只要敢动屠魔山谷，老子就敢把你们的爪子砍掉！”谁知道还有火气更大的，中年人都已经走出了老远，胖老头还在那喋喋不休的叫骂着，骂了好一阵子，才算是注意到大厅里还有人在，只见胖老头眉头一皱，盯着林立问道：“你是谁？”
“您就是葛瑞安会长吧？”林立赶紧翻了翻口袋，从里面掏出安度因的信递了过去：“我叫费雷，是安度因法师叫我来找您的，这是他给您写的一封信。”
“是安度因那老家伙！”胖老头一听安度因的名字，顿时双眼一亮，刚刚皱起的眉头也随之舒展开来，一张胖脸上笑容可鞠，看上去倒还真象个和气生财的商人：“那老家伙人呢？怎么只有你一个人过来？”
“安度因法师说他还有些事情要办，大概要过一两周才能回加洛斯城。”

“哦……”葛瑞安点了点头，开始看起手上的信来。
原本葛瑞安就有点奇怪，安度因虽然是加洛斯魔法公会成员之一，可这老家伙一向沉迷于药剂学，在公会几十年就没干过一件正事，偶尔露一次面，也大多是要材料要配方，今天这是吹的什么风，这老家伙居然给人写起介绍信来了……
可是看着看着，胖法师脸色就变了，原本笑得眯起的眼睛睁得有牛眼那么大，一边看着手上的信，还一边抬起头来看林立两眼，到了最后连拿信的手都仿佛在抖。
这这这……真要象信上说的，那这小子还是人吗？
听听那老家伙都说了些什么——足以媲美法师之神格雷斯科的魔法天赋！
看到这句话的时候，胖老头瞳孔都放大了，从小就听着法师之神的传说长大，那位黑暗年代最伟大的法师曾经干过些什么事，葛瑞安闭着眼睛都能数得出来，唯一能够对抗神祗的凡人，以一人之力歼灭高等精灵魔法军团的传奇，葛瑞安一直觉得，这样的人只应在神话中出现。
如果是别人这么说，葛瑞安一定会以为这是一个笑话，可是偏偏他心里很清楚，安度因的性格向来是说一是一说二是二，活了一百多岁，从来就没说过一句大话。
“捡到宝了捡到宝了……”葛瑞安眼睛虽然还在信上，心里却早已乐开了花，他现在真恨不得能拿起信来亲上几口，加洛斯魔法公会落魄了几十年，终于有翻身的机会了！
可还没等胖老头高兴完，一段字句却又跳入了眼中。
“另外，他还是一个药剂大师……”
“药剂大师……开什么玩笑！”葛瑞安拼命揉着眼睛，以为是自己看错了。
葛瑞安揉完眼睛，又把信纸捧起来看……
靠！真是药剂大师！
葛瑞安彻底斯巴达了，这这这……这简直比魔法天才还可怕呀！
自黑暗年代之后一千三百年，谁见过七十岁以下的药剂大师？葛瑞安悄悄从信纸间露出头来，仔细打量着这个叫费雷的年轻人，一件法师袍看似有些破旧，但上面透出的魔法波动却异常清晰，以葛瑞安的眼光，一眼就看出这绝不是一般的魔法物品，人长得高高瘦瘦，一张脸上还略带着几分稚气，看年纪，只怕还不超过二十岁……
而且信上还写到，这位年轻的药剂大师实力之强，绝不在药剂师公会任何人之下！
发了发了发了发了……这次是真发了！
一个不到二十岁的药剂大师，葛瑞安光是想想就已经激动得浑身发抖，从此以后，药剂师公会算什么，老子再也不用为了几瓶破药水求上门去，更用不着跟那些眼睛望天的药剂师打交道，妈的一个个水平不高架子倒是挺大，老子现在有药剂大师了，还用得着再看你们脸色？
“费雷法师是吗？”整封信看完，胖老头已经完全抽风了，望向林立的目光更是绿幽幽直勾勾的，让林立没来由的背心一阵发凉：“你的事情，安度因在信上都跟我说了，据他说，你好象还没进行过等级认证吧？”
“等级认证？”

一看林立疑惑的目光，葛瑞安就知道自己说了句废话，不由郁闷的拍了自己一巴掌，暗骂一声真是笨蛋，这小子才接触魔法两三个月，一直跟着安度因学习，又哪知道什么等级认证？
“简单的说，就是确认你的魔法等级，我个人觉得，对你来说，这很有必要，因为只有进行过等级认证之后，你才能够从魔法公会获得相应等级的咒语。”
在解释什么叫等级认证的时候，葛瑞安脸上虽然一直带着可鞠的笑容，可其实心里却是说不出的紧张，这关系到一个足以媲美格雷斯科的魔法天才，更关系到一个不满二十岁的药剂大师，葛瑞安甚至觉得，自己现在的心情，比当年晋阶大魔导士时更加紧张。
“那我什么时候可以进行等级认证？”林立回答得很干脆，因为他自己也很想知道，自己现在究竟是什么等级。
“随时可以！”葛瑞安拉着林立就往楼上走，一张胖脸因为憋得太过辛苦，已经完全扭曲掉了，他现在真想抱着安度因亲上几口，这老家伙实在太可爱了，等他回来一定要好好谢谢他才行。
content_en:
Chapter 12 Emerald Tower
The Magic Guild is located at the southern end of Garros City. It is a huge building that is no less impressive than the Adventurer's Guild. In Garros City, the Magic Guild is also known as the Emerald Tower. Standing on the street and looking from a distance, you can see the tall spire.
Lin Li asked a few passers-by on the road and quickly found the direction of the Emerald Tower.
Compared with the bustling Adventurer's Guild, it was unusually quiet under the Emerald Tower. Lin Li stood outside the gate and didn't hear a sound for a long time. Only a faint magic wave came from the tower. This magic wave made Lin Li feel majestic and mysterious, as if he was facing an insurmountable mountain.
Walking into the Emerald Tower from the gate, there is also a spacious hall inside.
At a glance, the hall was empty, not even a single person could be seen.
"What's going on..."
Lin Li was standing at the door in a daze when he suddenly heard a quarrel coming from upstairs.
"The City of Shadows wants to take control of the Demon Slaughter Valley? Yes! But you'd better be prepared to bleed!" An angry roar came from upstairs. Lin Li looked up and saw a round gray figure.
"President Greg, you are so irrational..." The person who was being driven out of the room by that figure was a middle-aged man in his forties. This middle-aged man was wearing a tight-fitting black leather armor, and there was a strong smell of blood all over his body. When he turned around, Lin Li suddenly felt as if he was being targeted by a poisonous snake.
Wait... President Grean?
Lin Li suddenly remembered that the name the middle-aged man called earlier seemed to be the person Anduin wanted to find himself.
Thinking of this, Lin Li couldn't help but take another look at the fat figure.
Only then did Lin Li notice that the figure in gray mage robes looked a bit older. He had a kind-faced look and was white and fat. Even when he was angry, he looked like he had a cute smile. Lin Li was a little dizzy. Such a fat old man, who looked more like a businessman than a mage, was actually the president of the Garros Magic Guild, the great mage Greg!
"President Grean, you are really irrational. Rejecting the friendship of the City of Shadows will only bring disaster to the Garros Magic Guild." The middle-aged man left the Emerald Tower without looking back after saying this. He just glanced at Lin Li as he passed by. The feeling as if he was being targeted by a poisonous snake made Lin Li's heart tighten for no reason.
"Why does this man walk without making any sound? Could it be that he is possessed by a ghost?" Lin Li was not a character who was willing to suffer losses. He was very uncomfortable with that look and naturally wanted to curse in his heart.
"Come if you dare! If you dare to touch the Demon Slaughter Valley, I will chop off your claws!" Who knows there are even more angry people? The middle-aged people have already walked far away, and the fat old man is still yelling and cursing. After cursing for a while, he finally noticed that there are still people in the hall. The fat old man frowned, stared at Lin Li and asked, "Who are you?"
"Are you President Grean?" Lin Li quickly rummaged through his pocket, took out Anduin's letter and handed it over: "My name is Feyre. Master Anduin asked me to come to you. This is a letter he wrote to you."
"It's that old guy Anduin!" When the fat old man heard Anduin's name, his eyes suddenly lit up, and the frown he had just frowned relaxed. He had a smile on his fat face, and he really looked like a businessman who was friendly and profitable: "What about the old guy? Why are you the only one here?"
"Mage Anduin said that he still has some things to do, and it will take about a week or two before he can return to Garros City."
"Oh..." Gregorian nodded and began to read the letter in his hand.
Grean was a little strange at first. Although Anduin was a member of the Garros Magic Guild, this old guyHe has always been addicted to pharmacy and has not done anything serious in the guild for decades. He shows up every once in a while and mostly asks for materials and formulas. What kind of wind is blowing today? This old guy actually writes a letter of introduction to someone...
But as he watched, the fat mage's expression changed. His eyes that were originally squinted with a smile were as big as a bull's eye. While looking at the letter in his hand, he raised his head to look at Lin Li. In the end, even the hand holding the letter seemed to be shaking.
If this and this...are really what the letter says, then is this kid still a human?
Listen to what the old guy said - the magical talent is comparable to that of the mage god Gresco!
When he saw this sentence, the fat old man's pupils dilated. He had grown up listening to the legend of the God of Mage. What the greatest mage in the dark ages had done, Greg could count with his eyes closed. The only mortal who could fight against the gods, the legend of annihilating the high elves magic legion with one person, Greg had always felt that such a person should only appear in myths.
If someone else had said this, Grean would have thought it was a joke, but he knew very well that Anduin's character had always been about saying one is one and two is two. He had lived for more than a hundred years and never said a big word.
"I found a treasure, I found a treasure..." Although Greg's eyes were still on the letter, his heart was already filled with joy. Now he really wished he could pick up the letter and kiss it a few times. The Garros Magic Guild had been in decline for decades, and finally had a chance to turn around!
But before the fat old man could finish being happy, another sentence jumped into his eyes.
"In addition, he is also a master of pharmacy..."
"Pharmacist Master...are you kidding me?" Gregorian rubbed his eyes desperately, thinking he had seen it wrong.
After rubbing his eyes, Greg picked up the letter and read it...
Damn it! What a master of potions!
Greg is completely Spartan, this and this... This is simply scarier than a magic genius!
Thirteen hundred years since the Dark Ages, who has seen a master pharmacist under the age of seventy? Grean quietly revealed his head from between the letters and looked at the young man named Fei Lei carefully. The mage's robe looked a little shabby, but the magic fluctuations revealed on it were extremely clear. From Grean's eyes, he could tell at a glance that this was no ordinary magic item. He was tall and thin, with a face that was slightly childish. Judging from his age, he was probably not more than twenty years old...
Moreover, the letter also stated that the strength of this young master pharmacist was definitely not inferior to anyone in the Pharmacist Guild!
I've made it, I've made it, I've made it... This time I've made it happen!
A pharmacist who is less than 20 years old, Gregorian is already shaking with excitement just thinking about it. From now on, what is the Pharmacist Guild? I no longer have to come to your door for a few bottles of broken potion, let alone deal with those pharmacists who look at the sky. Damn, they are not high-level, but they are very arrogant. Now that I have a pharmacist, do I need to look at your faces?
"Is this Master Fei Lei?" After reading the whole letter, the fat old man was completely convulsed. He looked at Lin Li with a green and direct gaze, which made Lin Li's vest shiver for no reason: "Anduin told me about you in the letter. According to him, you haven't gone through the level certification yet, right?"
"Level certification?"
As soon as he saw Lin Li's doubtful eyes, Grean knew that he had said nonsense. He couldn't help but slapped himself in frustration, cursing inwardly that he was really an idiot. This kid had only been exposed to magic for two or three months and had been studying with Anduin. How could he know what level certification it was?
"To put it simply, it is to confirm your magic level. I personally think that this is very necessary for you, because only after undergoing level certification can you obtain spells of the corresponding level from the Magic Guild."
When explaining what level certification is, Greg's face always had a smile on his face.Looking at Keju's smile, he actually felt unspeakable nervousness in his heart. This was related to a magic genius who could rival Gresco, and even more so to a master of pharmacy who was under twenty years old. Grean even felt that his mood now was more nervous than when he was promoted to Grand Mage.
"Then when can I undergo level certification?" Lin Li answered simply, because he himself also wanted to know what level he was at now.
"You can do it anytime!" Grean pulled Lin Li upstairs. His fat face was completely distorted from holding it in too hard. He really wanted to hold Anduin and kiss him a few times. This old guy was so cute. He must thank him properly when he comes back.
